findings.observation: The adult chibi remains recognizably Aear: near-ebony band-6 skin, mature soft rectangular face, wide-set eyes, low straight brow, prominent bridge, compact closed mouth, cheek mole, and restrained expression all survive the scale change.
The figure preserves Aear’s medium-height language and conditioned athletic construction with functional tone, stable shoulder and torso width, and no ripped or generically bulky redesign.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and empty hands remain proportionate to the compact body; neither the relaxed hand nor the waist-side fist shows generic chibi arm or hand inflation.
The red-copper-auburn asymmetric mass, shaved side, front and side silhouette, gathered locks, unruly tips, and segmented gold-wrapped crest closely preserve the summon’s defining hairstyle.

The marigold short mantle, high soft collar, cream tunic, green waist wrap and divided lower layers, uneven hems, wrapped boots, hair bindings, and small medicine pouch preserve the summon’s construction and palette with no added tattoo or new personal anchor.

Measured visually from crest top to chin and crest top to sole line, the complete head-and-hair unit occupies about 32.5% of standing height, approximately 3.08 heads tall and inside the required 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one subject appears, with the full crest, both empty hands, layered clothing, both legs, and both feet completely visible inside safe margins.
The broad hair silhouette, compact grounded stance, separated arms, layered hem shapes, and planted boots read clearly as a weaponless ready-idle combat figure at icon scale.
The presentation remains mortal and grounded: no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, levitation, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.
